The positive-rank uniqueness theorem needs recursion only on diagonal blocks, a weaker assumption than the paper. The new basis-dependent family adds the sum of squared off-diagonal entries to the canonical potential, and the rank-shift family adds zero in rank one and one otherwise. Identity scalar blocks in the recursion witness are SPD. No regularity or extra positivity assumptions were introduced.
